the_day: OpenAI announced healthcare agents, free model access for 200,000 researchers and outside safety assessments; Anthropic shortened its bug disclosure window and reportedly launched Claude Sheets; Google added Gemini voices and Maps features; Meta and xAI were quiet.

items.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Sheets spreadsheet tool, outlets report
points: Several outlets report Anthropic has launched Claude Sheets, a spreadsheet product.
Crypto Briefing describes it as a move into Microsoft's spreadsheet territory.
Cloud Wars reports Anthropic is bringing a range of productivity tools together inside Claude.
items.for_you: Claude users may have a new spreadsheet tool, but today's items give no details on which plans include it or what it costs.

sources.title: Anthropic launches Claude Sheets, taking aim at Microsoft’s spreadsheet turf

Anthropic Consolidates a Range of Productivity Tools and Functions Inside Claude
Anthropic Launches Claude Sheets. Is Microsoft's Stock in Trouble?

items.headline: Anthropic shortens its vulnerability disclosure window to 30 days
points: Anthropic updated the timelines in its coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy.
The Next Web reports the disclosure window is now 30 days.
The Next Web links the change to AI finding software flaws faster.
items.for_you: If Anthropic reports a flaw in software you maintain, The Next Web's report suggests you will have less time before it is disclosed.

sources.title: Updating our coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy timelines
Anthropic cuts its bug disclosure window to 30 days as AI finds flaws

items.headline: Anthropic says a recursive self-improvement risk alarm was triggered, Gizmodo reports
points: Gizmodo reports Anthropic says its recursive self-improvement alarm has been triggered.
Investor's Business Daily separately reports a group says Anthropic's AI acceleration is nearing risk thresholds.
Today's items do not say what steps, if any, Anthropic is taking in response.

sources.title: Anthropic Says Its Recursive Self-Improvement Alarm Has Been Triggered
Anthropic AI Acceleration Verges On Risk Thresholds, Group Says

items.headline: Gemini app adds 66 regional voices on Android and iOS
points: The Gemini app now offers 66 regional voices on Android and iOS.
Google says users can pick a voice with a natural, local dialect.
items.for_you: If you use the Gemini app on your phone, you can now pick a voice with a local dialect.

sources.title: Regional voices are rolling out in the Gemini app.

items.headline: Google adds holiday travel planning features to Ask Maps
points: Ask Maps can now help plan holiday road trips and give route tips.
Google says it can also find local appointments and search your saved lists.
items.for_you: Google Maps users can ask Maps to help plan trips and to search their saved places.

sources.title: New Ask Maps features to help with holiday travel and prep

companies.name: Meta
companies.quiet_line: No new product, policy or deal from Meta in today's items.

items.headline: ChatGPT for Healthcare adds computer-use agents and clinical plugins
points: OpenAI introduced computer-use agents for ChatGPT for Healthcare that work across healthcare software.
OpenAI says it also improved clinical answers and added new healthcare plugins.
items.for_you: Healthcare teams on ChatGPT for Healthcare get agents that can work inside the software they already use.

sources.title: More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare
Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams

items.headline: OpenAI expands free frontier model access to 200,000 researchers
points: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to give 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to its frontier models.
OpenAI also started a science blog and published a survey of more than 1,800 scientists on how they use ChatGPT.
items.for_you: Academic researchers may now qualify for free access to OpenAI's frontier models through the expanded program.

sources.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT

items.headline: OpenAI gives four outside groups embedded access to evaluate its models
points: OpenAI began embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire.
The groups will independently evaluate model alignment, safeguards and monitoring systems.
OpenAI calls this the first phase.

sources.title: Our first phase of embedded assessments

items.headline: OpenAI announces new tools against online child sexual abuse
points: OpenAI announced new tools, practical guidance and partnerships against online child sexual exploitation and abuse.
OpenAI says they are meant to help prevent, detect and respond to it.

sources.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support

items.headline: LVMH's media division signs partnership with OpenAI
points: LVMH's Media Division and OpenAI announced a partnership to support journalism with AI.
The deal aims to make LVMH's publications more accessible through ChatGPT.
items.for_you: ChatGPT users may see more content from LVMH's publications.

sources.title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
